newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi Aramco raises LPG contract prices for Sept.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Aramco raises LPG contract prices for Sept.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's state-owned oil firm Saudi Aramco said on Monday that it had raised its propane contract price for September by $10 from the previous month to $170 per tonne, and its price for butane by $5 to $180.
The propane price for September is up $23 from a year ago, and that for butane up $25 over the same period.
The Saudi contract price is loosely based on the results of three monthly spot tenders and the company's own assessment of spot market trends.
